description: Datadog monitors for the Discovery Map architecture. All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [Discovery] High empty results rate
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The Discovery Map is returning zero results at a rate of more than 5 empty responses per second over the last 10 minutes. Users are seeing empty states on the discovery page.

**Current value:** {{value}} req/s
**Threshold:** 5 req/s

**Actions:**
1. Check if the user table has sufficient active users.
2. Verify privacy_hide_from_search flag is not incorrectly set on all users.
3. Check if discovery filters are too restrictive.
4. Inspect the discovery service health endpoint.
5. Verify that mock data fallback is functioning for degraded states.
{{/is_alert}}

{{#is_warning}}
Empty discovery result rate elevated.
{{/is_warning}}

monitors.name: [Discovery] High request latency
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The average discovery API request duration has exceeded 5 seconds over the last 10 minutes. This is likely caused by slow Supabase/PostgreSQL queries (PostGIS, pg_trgm), missing indexes, or connection pool exhaustion.

**Current value:** {{value}}s
**Threshold:** 5s

**Actions:**
1. Check Supabase / PostgreSQL query performance (EXPLAIN ANALYZE on discovery queries).
2. Verify PostGIS spatial indexes exist on users(location).
3. Verify pg_trgm indexes exist on users(display_name), users(country), users(city).
4. Check for connection pool saturation or rate limiting.
5. Check Redis cache hit rate for discovery endpoints.
{{/is_alert}}

{{#is_warning}}
Discovery request latency elevated.
{{/is_warning}}

monitors.name: [Discovery] Cache miss rate high
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The discovery cache miss rate has exceeded 20 per second over the last hour. This indicates Redis is either unavailable, evicting keys prematurely, or the discovery cache invalidation service is not populating the cache.

**Current value:** {{value}} req/s
**Threshold:** 20 req/s

**Actions:**
1. Check Redis memory usage and eviction policy.
2. Verify the DiscoveryCacheInvalidationService cron jobs are running successfully.
3. Check if the Redis connection pool is exhausted.
4. Inspect discovery cache TTL configurations.
5. Verify that discovery cache interceptors are correctly applied to all endpoints.
{{/is_alert}}

{{#is_warning}}
Discovery cache miss rate elevated.
{{/is_warning}}

monitors.name: [Discovery] Circuit breaker open
[Discovery] No discovery activity for 30 minutes
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No discovery partner search requests have been recorded in the last 30 minutes. This indicates either a complete outage of the discovery pipeline or zero user activity on the discovery page.

**Actions:**
1. Check the discovery API health endpoint.
2. Verify the NestJS backend is running and Supabase connection is healthy.
3. Check if discovery page is rendering correctly in the frontend.
4. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
5. Verify that the Auth0/Supabase JWT authentication flow is not broken.
{{/is_alert}}
